name: 莉薇娅
src: 萨尔维斯/萨尔维斯时段_六_末年下.md:619
gear: 传奇｜上城｜法袍，不带法杖｜5档｜莉维乌斯家的女儿，传奇不看家境定五档；塔林的人学陛下穿素，她不披甲，只在下深矿穿的皮外套上打一层生骸银薄片，身边是她自己抽出来的骸银流光和环光（末年下战装补层：十塔的主人战装是身边的环光）。
who: Livia, a human legend of the Tower Grove, daughter of the upper-city house of Livius, master of bone-silver and the only one who can go down to the lowest levels of the deep mine; a legend for a century and a half, she looks about thirty-five: about 170 cm, tall, straight and composed. Long, heavy dark plum hair, almost black with a wine-red sheen, coiled low at the nape. Cold pale ice-blue eyes with a faint silver sheen, as if they have looked too long at bone-silver in the dark. The fingertips of both hands are dusted with a fine silver that never washes off. Silent after every descent; a reserved, cool, patrician air. Her hair is a deep plum so dark it reads almost black, with only a wine-red sheen in the highlights, NOT auburn or red-brown.
build: 170 cm, tall and slender: straight shoulders, long arms and long fingers, a narrow waist.
palette: dark plum, cold bone-silver, deep wine red, charcoal grey, ice blue
casual: Her Grove dress: a long plain charcoal-grey robe of fine wool closed down the front with key-shaped clasps, fitted sleeves bound at the wrist with black cord, no crest; a short deep wine-red shoulder cape lined in grey, the one sign of her house; a small bone-silver mine lamp hanging at her belt, its light cold white. She stands with her silver-dusted hands folded, a cool, unreadable look. The clasps are small flat bone-silver clasps shaped like plain keys, NOT knotted cord. Western cut, NOT a mandarin collar, NOT frog buttons or knotted cord fastenings.
private: Back up from the deep mine: the grey robe's sleeves pushed up, a heavy dark-grey hooded travelling cloak with the hood down, a few strands fallen from the coil of hair, the unlit mine lamp held loosely in her silver-dusted hands; a tired, distant look.
battle: Descending to the lowest level, in a deep-mine mage's dress made for a legend: the charcoal-grey robe under a long fitted coat of dark grey leather, plated at the shoulders and forearms with thin sheets of raw bone-silver engraved with fine ring-sigils that shine cold white; the wine-red shoulder cape; the bone-silver lamp at her belt; she carries no staff. From her raised right hand long ribbons of liquid bone-silver unspool into the air and curl around her in bright cold white arcs, and two rings of white rune-light turn slowly about her waist.
formal: At the tenth night's banquet: a floor-length gown of ivory satin with a low rounded Western neckline edged with a thin band of bone-silver, the bodice closed by a single straight row of small round bone-silver buttons, NO standing collar, NO loops or knotted fastenings; a near-black wine-red overgown open at the front, the hem and cuffs heavy with bone-silver embroidery glowing faint cold white, the plum hair coiled with a bone-silver pin. She stands very straight, the silver-dusted hands folded, a cool, aloof look.
art: A three-quarter portrait, the face turned slightly, the ice-blue eyes looking just past the viewer, cool and silent, the mouth closed. Cold white light rising from below as from bone-silver deep underground, deep shadow above. Foreground blur: a thread of glowing liquid silver drifting near the lens and the edge of the mine lamp. She wears the charcoal robe with the wine-red cape.
art_extra: The robe closes with small flat bone-silver key-shaped clasps, NOT knotted cord, NOT frog buttons or knotted cord fastenings; the hair stays deep plum, almost black.

name: 德鲁苏斯
src: 萨尔维斯/萨尔维斯时段_六_末年下.md:619
gear: 传奇｜贫（下城孤儿，从军团上来，★）｜照常，军人｜5档｜管军团的阵和引雷台，传奇不看家境定五档；十位里只有他披甲，照军团的旧灰甲打到顶，甲上存雷（帝国那一段引雷的军团甲存雷的推法），不罩贵族家色，留着褪白的旧军团斗篷。
who: Drusus, a human legend of the Tower Grove who commands the legion's war-arrays and the lightning-drawing platforms, a lower-city orphan who rose through the legion; a legend since about 9960, he looks about forty-five: about 186 cm, broad-shouldered and heavy-boned, a soldier's straight stance. Short steel-blue hair that always stands on end, lifted by the lightning stored in him. Bright electric-gold eyes. A thin pale scar across the bridge of the nose. Faint pale branching lightning marks run from the left wrist up the forearm (on the viewer's right when they face us). A bone-silver name ring on his right hand. A blunt, brisk, commanding air; he speaks fast and in numbers.
face: FACE, as in the references: a hard, square man's face of about forty-five, lines at the eyes and mouth, bright electric-gold eyes under thick steel-blue brows, a thin pale scar across the bridge of the nose, clean-shaven, a firm closed mouth. Skin shadows a soft warm tone.
build: 186 cm, broad and heavy-boned: thick shoulders and chest, strong arms, a soldier's straight back.
palette: legion grey-blue, steel blue, storm white, electric gold, bone-silver
casual: His everyday dress: a plain grey-blue legion officer's tunic to mid-thigh, belted, over grey trousers and tall black boots; an old grey-blue legion cloak whose embroidered ring of fire and two crossed keys has worn nearly white, fastened at the shoulder with a plain clasp; no house colours; the bone-silver name ring on the right hand. He stands with the hands clasped behind his back, a brisk, appraising look.
private: Off duty on a lightning platform: the tunic off, a loose grey linen shirt with the sleeves rolled to show the pale lightning marks on the left forearm, grey trousers and boots, the hair crackling upright. He holds a rolled array diagram under one arm, a gruff, relaxed look.
battle: Commanding the legion array, in a legend's harness of the old legion: full grey plate of the finest make, every plate edged with bone-silver lines that store lightning and throw thin white-blue arcs whenever he moves, a high gorget, sculpted pauldrons bearing the ring of fire and two crossed keys inlaid in bone-silver, the old grey-blue legion cloak over it; no house colours. In his right hand a tall staff of dark iron banded with bone-silver, a lightning-drawing rod whose forked head holds a caged white bolt; around him three wide rings of array sigils turn at waist, chest and shoulder height, lighting up name by name.
formal: At the banquet as a legend of the Grove: a long grey-blue wool robe with a stiff ring-shaped collar and key-shaped clasps, the hem embroidered with the ring of fire and crossed keys in bone-silver glowing faint cold white, the old legion cloak over one shoulder instead of any house colours, polished boots. He stands at attention, a stiff, impatient look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the electric-gold eyes looking at the viewer hard and quick, the mouth closed, the steel-blue hair lifting with static. Cold blue-white lightning light from one side, the low grey of a storm sky on the other. Foreground blur: a thin arc of lightning and the edge of a bone-silver ring.

name: 奥克塔维娅
src: 萨尔维斯/萨尔维斯时段_六_末年下.md:619
gear: 传奇｜中（镜湖学派请进塔林的人，★）｜法袍，不带法杖｜5档｜管镜术，传奇不看家境定五档；镜湖学派的人不披甲，五档落在镶镜湖玻璃珠的长外袍、骸银护臂和身边浮着的七面镜湖玻璃上。
who: Octavia, a human legend of the Tower Grove, master of mirror-craft and keeper of the underground palace beneath the Mirror Lake, invited into the Grove from the lake's own school; a legend since about 9990, she looks about twenty-eight: about 165 cm, slender and light. Long, softly waving sea-glass teal hair falling to the waist, held back from the face by a thin circlet of clear lake glass. Clear pale turquoise eyes. A round mirror of lake glass the size of a palm hangs at her belt on a fine chain. A calm, curious, faintly amused air; she watches reflections more than faces.
build: 165 cm, slender and light: narrow shoulders, a long neck, slim arms.
palette: sea-glass teal, clear lake-glass white, pale turquoise, soft silver-grey, a little deep blue
casual: Her Grove dress: a long pale silver-grey robe of fine wool with a small turned-down Western collar, the front closed by a single straight row of small round bone-silver buttons with plain buttonholes, NO standing collar, NO loops or knotted fastenings; fitted sleeves, a narrow sash of deep blue; along the hem a band of tiny lake-glass beads that catch the light; the palm-sized round mirror hanging at her belt on its chain; soft pale shoes. She holds one open hand up before her as if reading something in her palm, a calm, curious look.
private: At home in the mirror palace: a long deep blue Western dressing gown with a shawl collar and fitted sleeves, tied with a sash, NOT a crossed wrap collar, NOT wide hanging sleeves, the hair loose without the circlet, soft slippers; she holds a small glass cup of water up to the light, a quiet, amused look.
battle: Working mirror-craft, in a legend mirror-mage's dress: the silver-grey robe under a long fitted over-robe of deep blue with a high stiff collar, its seams set with lines of lake-glass beads shining cold white, bone-silver bracers engraved with ring-sigils on both forearms; she carries no staff. Around her float seven round panes of clear lake glass, each as wide as a shield, each catching and throwing back cold white light, two rings of white rune-light turning between them; the small mirror at her belt glows.
formal: At the banquet: a floor-length gown of ivory satin with a small turned-down Western collar, the front closed by a single straight row of small round bone-silver buttons with plain buttonholes, NO standing collar, NO loops or knotted fastenings; a sheer overgown of pale blue gauze sewn with tiny lake-glass beads like drops of water, the lake-glass circlet, the small mirror on its fine chain at the waist. She stands lightly, a faint amused smile with the lips closed.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the pale turquoise eyes looking at the viewer, calm and amused, the lips closed. Cool rippling light like light off water from one side, a soft white glow from the other. Foreground blur: the bright edge of a floating round pane of clear glass and a few drifting glass beads.
art_extra: The robe has a small turned-down Western collar and plain round bone-silver buttons, no loops or knots.
faces_extra: Where the collar shows, it is a small turned-down Western collar with plain round bone-silver buttons, no standing collar, no loops or knots.

name: 瓦莱里娅
src: 萨尔维斯/萨尔维斯时段_六_末年下.md:619
gear: 传奇｜中（东陆降城的孩子，入了瓦莱里乌斯家）｜照行当，不披金属甲｜5档｜管辨渊，传奇不看家境定五档；照辨渊师那一路（深灰袍、皮绳扎袖、兽皮罩衣、骸银镇纹、镜湖玻璃灯）打到传奇那一档，灯换成骸银长杖顶上的大灯。
who: Valeria, a human legend of the Tower Grove who masters beast-examination, the woman from whose academy the judgment lists come; born in a conquered city of the eastern continent and taken into the upper-city house of Valerius, her old name kept only in the family book; a legend since about 10010, she looks about forty: about 172 cm, lean and straight. Deep dark copper-red hair, not bright red, cut sharply at the jaw. Narrow dark jade-green eyes that study a person's shadow before the face. On her left wrist (on the viewer's right when they face us) a single plain clay bead on a faded cord, the one thing kept from her birth city. A severe, exact, unsmiling air. She clearly looks about forty: fine lines at the eye corners and between the brows, a lean severe mature face, NOT young; clearly dark jade-green eyes, NOT grey; deep dark copper-red hair.
face: FACE, as in the references: a lean, severe woman's face of about forty, fine lines at the eyes and between the brows, narrow dark jade-green eyes, straight dark copper brows, a straight nose, a thin closed mouth. Skin shadows a soft warm tone.
build: 172 cm, lean and straight: square shoulders, long arms, a narrow waist.
palette: deep examiner grey, dark copper red, cold bone-silver, lake-glass white, dark jade
casual: Her academy dress: a long deep grey wool robe with a small turned-down Western collar, the front closed by a single straight row of small round bone-silver buttons, NO knotted or looped fastenings, NO standing collar; the sleeves bound tight at the wrist with leather cords; a long open charcoal over-robe with a broad turned-down Western collar; the clay bead on her left wrist; a small bone-silver lamp with a clear lake-glass shade hanging at her belt. She holds a thick bound registry book under one arm, a cold, measuring look.
private: Late at the academy: the over-robe off, the grey robe's cords untied and the cuffs pushed back, a plain dark wool shawl, the clay bead on her wrist. She holds an open registry book in one hand and a pen in the other, a tired, hard look.
battle: Holding an examination, in a legend examiner's war dress: the deep grey robe under a long fitted coat of dark beast hide stitched all over with fine bone-silver ward lines glowing cold white, a high stiff collar edged in bone-silver, elbow-length gloves of the same hide, the sleeves cord-bound. In her right hand a tall staff of pale bone-silver crowned by a great lamp behind clear lake glass, its cold white light thrown forward; two rings of white rune-light turn about her waist, and the shadow-searching light of the lamp makes her own outline glow at the edges.
formal: At the banquet as a lady of the house of Valerius: a floor-length gown of ivory fine wool with a small turned-down Western collar, the front closed by a single straight row of small round bone-silver buttons, NO knotted or looped fastenings, NO standing collar; a near-black wine-red overgown, the hem embroidered in bone-silver with the ring of fire and crossed keys glowing faint cold white, the clay bead still on her wrist. She stands very straight, an unsmiling look.
art: A three-quarter portrait, the face turned slightly, the narrow jade-green eyes looking at the viewer as if checking the viewer's shadow, the mouth closed. Hard cold white lamplight from below on one side, deep shadow on the other. Foreground blur: the clear glass shade of a bone-silver lamp and the edge of a registry page.
art_extra: The robe has a small turned-down Western collar and plain round bone-silver buttons, no loops or knots, no standing collar.
faces_extra: Where the collar shows, it is a small turned-down Western collar with plain round bone-silver buttons, no standing collar, no loops or knots.

name: 马尔凯鲁斯
src: 萨尔维斯/萨尔维斯时段_六_末年下.md:619
gear: 传奇｜上城（贵族之子，★）｜法袍，不带法杖｜5档｜管塔影里的灯，传奇不看家境定五档；塔林的传奇不披甲，五档落在深酒红长外袍、镶着一粒粒小火晶的骸银肩披和他压住的永光、身边一圈圈浮灯上。
who: Marcellus, a human legend of the Tower Grove, a son of an upper-city noble house, keeper of the lamps in the towers' glow who knows where every lamp in the empire burns; a legend since about 10030, he looks about fifty-five: about 178 cm, a little stout and soft-handed, an unhurried bearing. Soft ash-blond hair tied back at the nape, a short neat ash-blond beard. Warm lamp-amber eyes, kind and tired. His fingertips glow faintly, as if he has just let go of a lamp. A mild, courteous, attentive air; he lowers his voice the way he lowers a light.
face: FACE, as in the references: a gentle, rounded man's face of about fifty-five, laugh lines at the eyes, warm lamp-amber eyes, soft ash-blond brows, a short neat ash-blond beard, a kindly closed mouth. Skin shadows a soft warm tone.
build: 178 cm, a little stout: soft broad shoulders, a rounded middle, plump careful hands. Visibly stout and soft: a rounded belly under the robe, a full face and plump hands, NOT slim.
palette: warm lamp gold, ivory white, ash blond, deep wine red, cold bone-silver
casual: His Grove dress: a long ivory wool robe closed with key-shaped clasps, fitted sleeves and a soft standing collar, a deep wine-red under-robe showing at the hem and cuffs; a single plain bone-silver house ring on the right hand; he carries no staff. He holds one hand at chest height, palm up, a small warm globe of light resting on it, a mild, attentive look.
private: Walking the lamps at night: a warm brown wool coat over the ivory robe, a long knitted scarf, soft boots; he carries a small brass hand-lamp with its flame turned low, a quiet, contented look.
battle: Pressing down the eternal light, in a legend lamp-master's vestment: the ivory robe under a long open over-robe of deep wine red lined in ivory, its edges embroidered with bone-silver lamp-and-ring patterns glowing cold white, a short bone-silver mantle across the shoulders set with clear crystals that each hold a small steady flame; he carries no staff. His right hand is raised, palm down, pressing a wide disc of brilliant white light flat in the air before him, and dozens of small floating lamp-lights hang in rings around him, all leaning toward his hand.
formal: At the banquet: a floor-length robe of ivory satin with a stiff ring-shaped collar and key-shaped clasps, a near-black wine-red overgown heavy with bone-silver embroidery glowing faint cold white, the house ring on his finger, the ash-blond hair neatly tied. He stands with the hands folded at the waist, a mild, courteous smile with the lips closed.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the warm amber eyes looking at the viewer kindly and tiredly, a faint closed-mouth smile. Warm golden light from a small globe of light cupped in his hand near the chin, cool night blue behind. Foreground blur: several small floating lamp-lights out of focus.

name: 弗拉维安
src: 萨尔维斯/萨尔维斯时段_六_末年下.md:619
gear: 传奇｜不详（★）｜朴素，学陛下｜5档｜十位里最年轻的，管陛下交给他的事；传奇定五档，平日学陛下穿一件没有徽记的素袍，五档落在暗紫衬里绣骸银小钥的长外套、骸银护臂和身后锁环一样的环光上，不带法杖。
who: Flavian, the youngest legend of the Tower Grove, born about 10000 and a legend since about 10065, entrusted with whatever the emperor asks of him and nothing anyone else knows; he looks about twenty-five: about 176 cm, slim and quick, a grown man. Glossy black hair with a blue sheen, cut short at the back and falling over the brow. Deep violet eyes, watchful and quick. A single small bone-silver earring shaped like a key in his left ear (on the viewer's right when they face us). On a fine chain at his chest a small locked bone-silver case. A light, polite, quick-talking air that gives nothing away.
build: 176 cm, slim and quick: narrow shoulders, long legs, light hands.
palette: near-black charcoal, glossy blue-black, deep violet, cold bone-silver, a little ivory
casual: His Grove dress, as plain as the emperor's: a long unmarked robe of near-black charcoal wool closed down the front with small key-shaped clasps, fitted sleeves, no crest and no trim; a narrow belt; the small locked bone-silver case on its chain at his chest; soft dark shoes; no staff. He stands with one hand resting on the case, an easy, guarded smile with the lips closed.
private: Off the record: the charcoal robe open over a plain ivory shirt, the sleeves pushed up, the black hair untidy; he holds a sealed letter between two fingers, a light, unreadable look.
battle: Doing what the emperor asked, in a legend's dress that hides its purpose: the plain charcoal robe under a long fitted dark coat with a high collar, its lining deep violet worked with tiny bone-silver key-shaped sigils that glow cold white where the coat falls open; bone-silver bracers engraved with ring-sigils; he carries no staff. Behind him hang several interlocking rings of cold white rune-light, closed like the wards of a lock, and above his raised left hand a single thin key of white light turns slowly in the air.
formal: At the banquet: a floor-length robe of ivory satin with a stiff ring-shaped collar, a near-black overgown lined in deep violet, the hem embroidered with bone-silver keys glowing faint cold white, the key earring, the locked case on its chain. He stands at ease, a polite closed-mouth smile.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the deep violet eyes looking at the viewer with a quick, guarded amusement, the mouth closed. Cold white rune-light from one side, deep shadow on the other. Foreground blur: the edge of a ring of white light and the corner of a sealed letter.
